user.title: Set up Bluetooth Device GPS
user.description: Track devices with the Bluetooth connection and location of the Home Assistant Companion app. Devices are added afterwards with the **Add device** button.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Bluetooth Device GPS is already set up.

user.title: Add device
user.description: The device follows the phone connected to any of its Bluetooth addresses and stays where it was parked when the phone disconnects.

data_description.macs: Pick a device known to your phones or type a MAC address such as 00:0E:9F:7F:77:DC.
data_description.picture: Optional. Leave empty to keep the current picture.

edit_vehicle.description: The device follows the phone connected to any of its Bluetooth addresses and stays where it was parked when the phone disconnects.

data_description.macs: Pick a device known to your phones or type a MAC address such as 00:0E:9F:7F:77:DC.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure device

menu_options.set_location: Set the location on the map

set_location.title: Set the location
set_location.description: Place the device on the map. It is moved right away and keeps following phones as usual afterwards.

error.invalid_mac: One of the addresses is not a valid MAC address.
error.no_macs: Add at least one Bluetooth address.
error.mac_in_use: An address is already used by another device.
error.invalid_picture: The picture must be a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP image of at most 10 MB.

abort.not_loaded: The integration is not loaded yet, try again in a moment.

data_description.phones: Only these phones can move devices. Leave empty to allow every phone with the Bluetooth connection sensor enabled.
data_description.disconnect_grace: The location is requested the moment the last phone disconnects. The device is only parked once this time has passed, so a short drop or an engine restart (the phone reconnecting in between) does not park it.
data_description.fix_timeout: How long to keep trying to get an accurate location after the disconnect before using the best one available (default 5 minutes).
data_description.max_accuracy: A location at least this accurate (metres) is accepted as the parking spot. The first one that arrives wins.

set_location.name: Set location
set_location.description: Moves a device to the given coordinates.

location.name: Location
location.description: Pick the position on the map. The radius is used as the accuracy.

no_bluetooth_sensor.title: No phone with the Bluetooth connection sensor
no_bluetooth_sensor.description: No Companion app phone has an enabled **Bluetooth connection** sensor, so devices cannot be tracked. Enable it in the Android app (Settings → Companion app → Manage sensors → Bluetooth connection) and, if needed, in the entity settings in Home Assistant. iOS does not provide this sensor.
